problem_statement: When network data carries a Prefix TLV whose encoded prefix length differs from the Context TLV's Context Length field, the lowpan 6LoWPAN context's reported prefix length is wrong. For a Prefix TLV of 2001:db8:0:1::/64 accompanied by a Context TLV whose Context Length byte is, say, 32 (or any value other than 64, including values above 128), the context's prefix length is reported as the Context Length value instead of 64. The context prefix length must always be taken from the outer Prefix TLV regardless of the (deprecated) Context Length field.
oracle_note: observed by validate_instance.py (fail before, pass after the fix); the unit oracle is per executable, so check attribution of the cases to the PR's change
